game_abilities.desc_zh: 战斗开始时有 6 个护盾增益，每个护盾增益将一次攻击造成的伤害上限限制为对手攻击评级的 {{var_1}}。 </s>每次犀牛受到基本或重型近战攻击时都会被移除。
远程攻击30%几率触发流血，造成攻击力60%的伤害，持续5秒

game_abilities.title_en: While Rhinox's Shield is active, powerful enemy attacks cannot deal more than {{var_2}} of the opponent's Attack Rating in a single hit.
game_abilities.desc_zh: 当犀牛之盾激活时，强大的敌人攻击在单次攻击中造成的攻击评级不能超过 {{var_2}}。

game_abilities.title_en: Shield Buffs recharge in {{var_3}}seconds. (cooldown on HUD as of December 2019)
game_abilities.desc_zh: 护盾增益在 {{var_3}} 秒内充能。 （HUD 冷却时间截至 2019 年 12 月）

game_abilities.title_en: +{{var_4}} Burn and Shock Resistance while Shielded.
game_abilities.desc_zh: +{{var_4}} 屏蔽时的耐燃烧性和耐冲击性。

game_abilities.title_en: Basic Melee Attacks: +{{var_5}} damage against Bleeding targets.
game_abilities.desc_zh: 基本近战攻击：对流血目标造成 +{{var_5}} 伤害。

game_abilities.title_en: Chaingun Ranged Attacks: {{var_6}} chance to inflict Bleed, dealing {{var_7}} Attack over {{var_8}}.
game_abilities.desc_zh: 链枪远程攻击：{{var_6}} 几率造成流血，造成 {{var_7}} 攻击超过 {{var_8}}。

game_abilities.title_en: <s>{{var_9}}</s> {{var_10}} chance to drain {{var_11}} of the target's max Power and inflict Power Lock for {{var_12}}.
game_abilities.desc_zh: <s>{{var_9}}</s> {{var_10}} 有机会耗尽目标 {{var_11}} 的最大能量并对 {{var_12}} 造成能量锁定。

game_abilities.title_en: When this ability is triggered, its chance to trigger again is reduced by {{var_13}}. This returns to normal after {{var_14}}.
game_abilities.desc_zh: 当该能力被触发时，其再次触发的几率会减少 {{var_13}}。这在 {{var_14}} 后恢复正常。
